Cause is clear and local: with an Xcode 27 build the system Liquid Glass tab bar applies, and .toolbarBackground(Color.white, for: .tabBar) paints an opaque slab over it. Fix: remove the modifier (target is iOS 26, so no #available gate is needed). agent-device is used only to capture evidence. Reproduce on the iOS 27 simulator before, L4 after (light/dark, scrolled content under the bar), L2 xcodebuild, and check the other tabs.
